tagline: Library of agent skills for CAD, CAE and CAM

evaluation.by: cadgen STEP validation: closed, oriented solids

examples.prompt: Design a 3D-printable planetary gear set: a 12-tooth sun, three 18-tooth planets and a 48-tooth ring gear with mounting lugs, module 1.5 and 8 mm thick, plus a carrier on steel pins. Give each part its own colour.
examples.caption: Planetary gear set · 9 coloured parts, involute teeth, zero interference · STEP assembly

examples.prompt: Design a phone stand for a phone 75 mm wide and 9 mm thick, holding it at 60 degrees, with a cable slot at the bottom, printable without supports.
examples.caption: Phone stand · 60° cradle with cable slot · STEP + STL, 100 × 70 × 95 mm
